integrity: All claims rest on the supplied explicit proof; finite direct graph enumeration and transfer checks are supplemental, reproducible tests.
scientific_limitations: The correspondence requires uniform clique fibers of size at least two. It is not claimed that the ordinary lexicographic-product maximum induced matching number is novel. The exact enumeration and purity priority may depend on implicit earlier results; finite tests do not prove unrestricted claims, and no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Induced-matching enumerators of clique blowups and exceptional purity on cyclic bases
